concerns.text: FR-001 mandates fetching the full canonical dataset (N≥1000) with a fallback to CSD. Tasks T041 (streaming download) and T042 (strict fail on fetch) are marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`). Without these, the core data ingestion requirement for the full dataset is unimplemented, leaving the project unable to satisfy the minimum sample size constraint.

FR-008 and SC-003 require classifying dominant intermolecular interaction types using geometric criteria extracted from CIFs. Tasks T035.1 (extract criteria), T035.2 (classify), and T043 (robust parser) are marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`). This leaves a core functional requirement and success criterion completely unimplemented.

Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene) and IV (Single Source of Truth) mandate checksumming all data artifacts and generating contracts/quickstart. Tasks T037 (final checksums) and T039 (generate quickstart/contracts) are marked as uncompleted (`- [ ]`), violating non-negotiable constitution principles regarding data integrity and provenance.

Task T004.1 triggers the CSD fallback if T004 fails to reach 1000 'valid molecule threshold'. However, FR-001 specifies the fallback is for 'insufficient number of valid organic small molecules'. The task conflates 'retrieved IDs' with 'valid molecules', potentially triggering the fallback prematurely if 1000 IDs are retrieved but <1000 are valid organic molecules.

Task T028.2 explicitly excludes the 'Control Analysis' model from the Bonferroni correction count (n=2). However, SC-005 requires multiple-comparison correction when comparing ≥2 models (RF, GB) against the baseline. The Control Analysis (T026) produces predictions tested in T028.1. Excluding it from the correction count creates ambiguity on whether the statistical rigor of SC-005 is fully met.
